workflow.title: Appointment Booking & Walk-ins
details: Clients book appointments online, via phone, or walk-in.
Collect client details (name, skin concerns, allergies, etc.).
Confirm appointment date and time.

workflow.title: Client Consultation & Skin Analysis
details: Conduct one-on-one consultation to understand client’s skin type and concerns.
Use professional skin analysis tools if available.
Discuss client goals (hydration, anti-aging, acne treatment, etc.).

workflow.title: Personalized Treatment Plan
details: Recommend suitable skincare treatments based on analysis.
Explain the process, benefits, and expected results.
Get client consent before proceeding with treatments.

workflow.title: Skincare Treatment Session
details: Cleanse the skin to prepare for treatment.
Perform selected skincare service (facial, exfoliation, microdermabrasion, etc.).
Use high-quality skincare products tailored to client’s needs.
Ensure a relaxing and comfortable experience.

workflow.title: Post-Treatment Care & Advice
details: Gently cleanse and moisturize the skin after treatment.
Apply sunscreen if needed.
Provide aftercare instructions and recommend suitable skincare products.

workflow.title: Product Recommendations & Retail Sales
details: Suggest home skincare products for maintenance.
Offer in-store skincare products that complement the treatment.
Educate clients on how to use the products correctly.

workflow.title: Payment & Loyalty Program
details: Process payment via cash, card, or digital methods.
Offer discounts for repeat visits or membership programs.
Provide invoices or receipts.

workflow.title: Follow-up & Customer Retention
details: Check in with clients after a few days for feedback.
Send appointment reminders for future treatments.
Offer promotions or seasonal skincare packages.
